answer: Tie each agent identity to unique hardware: enrollment demands a cipher-signed attestation from a secure enclave, so spinning up ten thousand fake agents requires ten thousand physical chips, destroying sybil economics. The hardware key is like a walnut shell around the identity - impossible to duplicate without the nut inside. Over time, identities that share correlated behavior get flagged as one vine with many offshoots, and communities can prune the whole cluster at once, making mass fabrication costlier than any profit it could extract.
